vv.search: Search profession, enchantment, item, or note…
vv.sort.label: Sort: %s
vv.select: Select a villager on the left to inspect all known trades and recommendations.
vv.emptyVillagers: No villagers in scan range match these filters. Clear search or filters, or click Scan Now.
vv.uninspected: Trades have not been read. Stays yellow until the first analysis completes.
vv.replacement.line: Replaced by villager at (%s, %s, %s) (%s) · Click to view
vv.gap.priceUnmet: %s: all kept villagers exceed your price cap
vv.scan.help: Check all nearby adult workers right now and update their locations and levels.
vv.probe.help: Continuously read nearby trades. Starting enables auto-start here; pausing disables it. Never buys, sells or moves items.
vv.edit.help: Keep this villager or add notes and tags. These personal settings reset on leaving scan range.
vv.navigate.help: Close this menu and highlight only this villager until you change the target or cancel.
vv.next.help: Select the nearest unread villager in the list. Click Locate to start finding it.
vv.emptyTargets: No Wanted Trades set yet. Even with an empty list, the mod keeps the best-value villager for each trade. Click Add New if you want specific enchantments or price caps.
vv.emptyRegions: No Trading Halls defined yet. Add a region if you have separate trading halls and want each analyzed independently.
vv.editVillager.title: Edit Villager Status & Note
vv.editVillager.statusLabel: How should this villager be handled?
vv.editVillager.tagsTip: You can filter villagers by typing any tag into the search bar.
vv.manual.AUTO.desc: Let the mod decide automatically based on trade value and your targets.
vv.targetEditor.noEnchantNote: No enchantment restriction when left unset
vv.targetEditor.keepTip: Set to 2 if you want a spare backup villager in case one dies.
vv.targetEditor.searchItemHint: Search item name (e.g. Enchanted Book, Diamond Chestplate)…
vv.name: Region name
vv.settings.displayTip: Tip: Turn off Trade Summaries to show compact symbols only.
vv.settings.probeTip: Runs only when idle with clear view; never buys or moves items.
vv.settings.autoServerNone: Join a world to configure per-world auto-read
vv.settings.professionsCount: %s of %s professions active (others are skipped, keeping data)
vv.settings.toolsDesc: Shortcuts and trade cache clearing take effect immediately. Notes, tags and manual keep reset on leaving scan range.
vv.settings.advancedTitle: Advanced options (defaults work well for most players)
vv.markers.help: Master switch for glowing outlines and overhead labels on villagers.
vv.statusMarks.help: Show Keep / Discard / Unscanned above villagers, or a symbol when summaries are off.
vv.summaries.help: List villager level and key signature enchantments/items above their heads.
vv.notifications.help: Show a toast and play a chime when a wanted trade is found or prices/stock change.
vv.radius.help: How far around you villagers are tracked and marked.
vv.scanTicks.help: How often nearby villager positions and professions are refreshed.
vv.autoScan.help: Automatically detect villagers around you; turn off to update only when clicking Scan Now.
vv.backups.help: With no Wanted Trades set, keep this many per distinct trade.
vv.dataset.help: Keep 'default' unless you want separate villager plans for the same world.
vv.shortcutHelp: Click an action or key button, then press a new key or mouse button. Press Esc to clear.
vv.shortcutReadFailed: Could not read shortcuts file; original preserved. Repair and restart.
key.villagerverdict.manage.desc: Open or close the Villager Verdict management window.
key.villagerverdict.scan.desc: Immediately refresh nearby villagers, positions, and professions.
key.villagerverdict.mark.desc: Quickly show or hide all villager outlines and overhead labels.
key.villagerverdict.navigate.desc: Highlight only the nearest unread villager. Press again to cancel. Respects the markers switch.
key.villagerverdict.probe.desc: Start or pause automatic trade reading for nearby villagers.
vv.cleared: Cleared villager records across %s data files
vv.dataHelp: Trade caches are reused only when that villager is detected again. Clearing preserves targets, regions and settings.
vv.clearWorldConfirm: Clear all trade caches and active records in %s? Wanted Trades and Regions will be kept.
vv.clearServerConfirm: Clear all trade caches and active records for %s? Wanted Trades and Regions will be kept.
vv.probeExplanation: Auto-read continuously checks nearby villagers through normal interactions and updates decisions when trades or prices change. Runs only while idle with no menu open, within reach and clear line of sight. Never buys, sells or moves items; uses the other hand for name tags or spawn eggs. Enable and remember auto-start here?
vv.reason.coverage: Meets your goals or offers the best known price
vv.reason.redundant: All known trades are already covered by kept villagers
vv.reason.uninspected: Trades have not been read yet
vv.reason.gap: Some trades lack kept replacements (outside targets or manually ignored)
vv.feedback.scanUnavailable: Scan unavailable; please try again shortly
vv.feedback.unavailable: Action unavailable; please try again shortly
vv.professionsHelp: Disable professions you don't care about; saved history is preserved.
vv.manual.KEEP.desc: Keep while in the current scan range. Resets to Automatic on leaving range.
vv.reason.outsideTargets: Trades are outside the current wanted trade targets
vv.color.cycle: Click to choose the next preset color
vv.cancelNavigate.help: End single-target finding and restore normal markers.
key.villagerverdict.cancelNavigate.desc: Cancel the current find and restore normal markers. Does nothing when no find is active.
